text.transitDepotPools501: function transitDepotPools501(){const pools={};for(const[mode,m]of Object.entries(TRANSIT_DEPOT_META501))pools[mode]={mode,nm:m.nm,ic:m.ic,base:m.base,built:0,online:0,builtCapacity:0,onlineCapacity:0,capacity:m.base,requested:0,ratio:1,jobs:0,upkeep:0,roots:[]};const scan=tickBld&&tickBld.length?tickBld:Array.from({length:N*N},(_,i)=>i);for(const i of scan){const b=tiles&&tiles[i]?.bld,m=TRANSIT_DEPOT_BY_K501[b?.k];if(!m||b.ref)continue;const p=pools[m.mode],on=transitDepotOperational501(i,b,m.mode);p.built++;p.builtCapacity+=m.capacity;p.jobs+=m.jobs;p.upkeep+=m.upkeep;if(on){p.online++;p.onlineCapacity+=m.capacity;}p.roots.push({root:i,on});}for(let r=0;r<busRoutes.length;r++)if(busRoutes[r].stops.length>=2)pools.bus.requested+=Math.max(0,busOpsCfg468[r].fleet|0);for(const L of tramLines463)if(L.stops.length>=2)pools.tram.requested+=Math.max(0,L.fleet|0);for(const L of railLines463)if(L.stops.length>=2)pools.rail.requested+=Math.max(0,L.fleet|0);for(const L of metroLines)if((L.path||[]).length>=2)pools.metro.requested+=Math.max(0,L.trains|0);for(const p of Object.values(pools)){p.capacity=p.base+(window.__noDepot501||window.__noTransitOps501?p.builtCapacity:p.onlineCapacity);p.ratio=p.requested>0?clamp(p.capacity/p.requested,0,1):1;p.spare=Math.max(0,p.capacity-p.requested);}return pools;}
